intended_object: The order isomorphism Fin 2 ≅ {a, b}, sending 0 ↦ a and 1 ↦ b, for elements a < b of a preordered type, with {a, b} seen as a two-element finset (docstring).
explanation:
This is a faithful definition. The body builds the map `![a, b]` from `Fin 2` into the subtype of `{a, b}`. It is strictly monotone because a < b, and surjective because every element of {a, b} is a or b. `StrictMono.orderIsoOfSurjective` then turns such a map into an order isomorphism. The lemmas `orderIsoPair_zero` and `orderIsoPair_one` give 0 ↦ a and 1 ↦ b by `rfl`, which matches the intended object.

The generality is natural. The construction only needs a preorder, and `DecidableEq` is needed to form the finset `{a, b}`. The closest general Mathlib construction is `Finset.orderIsoOfFin`, which needs a linear order, so this definition is more general than it on this special case, not narrower. The definition is used for faces of standard simplices in `Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialSet/StdSimplex.lean`.
